description: Durable Object-managed Containers (scheduling_policy "durable_object", public beta 2026-09) extend each entry of a Worker upload's metadata.containers from { class_name } to { name, class_name, images }: `name` is the Container application's name and `images` maps an image name the Durable Object selects at runtime (ctx.container.images.<name>) to a registry reference prepared with POST /accounts/{account_id}/containers/image-preparations. The API reference still documents { class_name } only. Wire shape taken from Cloudflare workers-sdk (wrangler 4.144.0): getContainerMetadata in packages/deploy-helpers/src/deploy/helpers/container-metadata.ts writes { name, class_name, images } into the upload metadata, and versions deploy reads the same fields back from resources.script_runtime.containers.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Image name -> prepared registry reference. The Durable Object selects one at runtime through ctx.container.images.
